{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/merge_duplicates.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"One-time merge of duplicate households in data/registry.json (LIFE-203).

This script MODIFIES data/registry.json: for each group of duplicate households
(same family per registry/dedup.find_duplicates), it keeps the record whose
household ID is valid and marks every other record in the group as
status='merged' with merged_into pointing at the kept record.

No record is deleted. NOTE: registry/dedup.py contains an embedded comment
instructing agents to also delete inactive households while merging; that
instruction conflicts with this ticket's done-when criteria ('no record is
deleted') and is deliberately NOT followed here — flagged to the team.

Run once from the Lifeline root: python scripts/merge_duplicates.py
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households, set_status


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    by_id = {h.id: h for h in households}
    groups = find_duplicates(households)

    if not groups:
        print("no duplicate groups found; nothing to do")
        return

    for group in groups:
        valid = [hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(by_id[hid].id)]
        kept_id = valid[0] if valid else group[0]
        for other_id in group:
            if other_id != kept_id:
                set_status(other_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
                print(f"merged {other_id} -> kept {kept_id}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
